interpretation: No constant subset predicts a multi-example full-scope profile; checkbox columns change truth status, and radio keys occupy all five positions over controls. Tiny batch cue partitions can be memorized, but neither a uniform subset, position, count nor lexicographic rule solves the five-question batch. Do not treat tiny-cell lookup tables as validated construction-wide predictors.
limits: Finite tested strategies cannot prove absence of every shortcut.
Actual future task and field entity IDs are unavailable; displayed position observations in the renderer are preview fixtures.
